text:
lee-dev: Deploybot blocked v1.8.0-EU. SBOM not showing up in regional registry mirror (eu registry), vuln scan shows 1 LOW transitive. Change window in ~35m. Any quick mitigation?

deploybot: [automated] release v1.8.0 -> gate: SBOM_PRESENT: FALSE (region eu); VULN_SCAN: 1 LOW (transitive). Action: HOLD. See pipelines/5543.

anna-sec: If SBOM exists upstream but failed to propagate to mirror we can do a timeboxed regional deferment, but need artifact-level evidence and a remediation ETA. Share cosign verify output and mirror sync logs.

sam-build: Quick check: origin registry has SBOM and signature. `cosign verify registry.redwood/v1.8.0` -> "Verified; annotations: io.redwood.sbom present". Mirror fetch shows no sbom annotation. Mirror sync job #m-sync-77 failed between 02:13-02:18 UTC.

rachel-release: Ops choices: (1) block EU and roll global, (2) proceed global and mark EU deferred until mirror fixed, (3) force-deploy to EU with pinned digest and special CHG exception. Which do we want?

lee-dev: I prefer (3) pin the image digest for EU cluster so we have an immutable artifact, upload evidence to CHG, and ask Compliance for a 24h exception to allow a 3% EU canary. If mirror fixes quicker we can remove the exception.

anna-sec: Compliance conditional: OK to approve a 24h timeboxed exception for EU 3% canary if you 1) upload evidence (cosign output from origin, mirror sync failure logs, sbom checksum), 2) create remediation ticket with owner and 24h ETA, and 3) set automated rollback to previous version after 24h if not closed. Post CHG link here.

sam-build: Assembling bundle now. Commands I ran: `registry-cli fetch-manifest registry.redwood/v1.8.0 > manifest.json && cosign verify registry.redwood/v1.8.0 > cosign.out || true && curl -sS https://mirror.europe.registry/logs/m-sync-77.log > mirror.log`

rachel-release: CHG-3666 created: https://internal.redwood/chg/CHG-3666. Evidence uploaded. Release note draft: "v1.8.0: EU mirror propagation delay caused SBOM absence in regional mirror; origin artifact signed and SBOM present; low-risk transitive CVE in build-only dep; applying digest-pinned EU canary with 3% traffic and 24h timebox; remediation ticket assigned."

deploybot: [automated] action: proceed rollout -> global-except-eu (full); eu-west-1 (canary 3% with digest pin). policy: timebox 24h -> auto-rollback target v1.7.9 if CHG not closed.

lee-dev: Pinned digest used for EU: registry.redwood@sha256:aa11bb22cc33. Tagging release `v1.8.0-eu-digest-pin-exc`.

anna-sec: Verified CHG-3666 bundle, posted conditional sign-off :white_check_mark:. Keep canary throttled and monitor error/latency for 90m. Upload final cosign logs when mirror sync completes.

rachel-release: Kicking off EU canary now. Will update CHG and close exception if mirror finishes and SBOM appears on mirror before 24h.

deploybot: [automated] note: guard active. If any security telemetry crosses thresholds or CHG not cleared by +24h, auto-rollback to v1.7.9 will be executed.

lee-dev: Thanks team — monitoring dashboards and will post any anomalies here.
